Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[High Anxiety]]: the theatrical release poster of Mel Brooks's 1977 film ''High Anxiety''.

Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:High_Anxiety_movie_poster.jpg File:High Anxiety movie poster.jpg], English Wikipedia (220 by 335 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251019032146/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:High_Anxiety_movie_poster.jpg Internet Archive], 19 October 2025.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a low-resolution copy (220 by 335 pixels) of the film's poster, the work the card's title refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
